description: This file defines the 'GenericRequester' interface which specifies methods for asynchronously receiving results or exceptions from service calls in the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: GenericRequester
classes.description: An interface for handling asynchronous responses and exceptions from service calls.

methods.name: receiveResult
methods.description: Callback method to receive the result of an asynchronous service call.

methods.name: receiveThrowable
methods.description: Callback method to receive an exception thrown during an asynchronous service call.
